# South Citi Care Dental Clinic

> Speciality dental clinic in New Alipore, Kolkata, run by Dr. Anish Bharti (BDS, M.D.S Prosthodontics & Crown Bridge, Certificate in Dental Implantology) and Dr. Aditi Bharti (BDS). Rated 4.9 stars from 62 Google reviews. Known for painless root canals and for quoting the full treatment price before any procedure begins.

## Contact
- Address: 23B/40/1A, near PNB, Mani Aangan, Block B, New Alipore, Kolkata 700053, India
- Phone: +91 99034 50487
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919903450487
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 9:30 AM to 9:30 PM; Sunday by appointment

## Services
- Root canal (single sitting where the tooth allows it)
- Dental implants (in-house implantologist)
- Crowns and bridges
- Braces and clear aligners
- Kids' dentistry
- Teeth whitening and smile design
- Fillings and gum treatment
- Laser dentistry where suitable
- Same-day emergency slots

## Facts
- Both dentists trained at Dr. R. Ahmed Dental College, Kolkata.
- Awards: 17th IPS PG Convention (winner), 51st IDA West Bengal State Annual Conference.
- Treatment plans are explained and priced in writing before they begin; the price does not change mid-treatment.
